text:
emma: heads-up — onboarding sample-rust-app broken. REST supports model_version pinning on /v1/generate (model_version=2025-02-01) but rust-sdk doesn't accept model_version so sample can't pin to our stable eval model. customer hit non-deterministic outputs.

toby: can you paste the curl that worked and the Rust snippet that failed?

emma: curl that worked:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4x","model_version":"2025-02-01","prompt":"summarize","max_tokens":100}'
```

emma: Rust code (redwood-rs v0.1.3):
```rust
let client = Redwood::new(&std::env::var("REDWOOD_KEY")?);
let resp = client.generate(&GenerateOptions {
    model: "gpt-4x".into(),
    prompt: "summarize".into(),
    max_tokens: Some(100),
    // no model_version field available in structs
    ..Default::default()
}).await?;
```

emma: result: SDK used server default model version (rolling) -> different outputs per request; customer needs stable pinned version. Also found: when token has insufficient scope we see SDK retrying for ~40s and then fail; REST returns 403 immediately.

sasha: thanks. two issues: (1) generator didn't include model_version in Rust structs because openapi used nullable/oneOf and our rust-codegen flattened differently, (2) retry middleware treats 403/401 as retryable. we had previously fixed this in other SDKs but not rust.

toby: quick workaround: call REST from Rust using reqwest and include model_version in body. ugly but unblocked the demo. example helper in sample-rust-app: https://github.com/redwood/sample-rust-onboard/pull/5

ci-bot: failing test redwood-rs/tests/integration/pinned_model_test.rs on main (expects model_version param present).

sasha: plan: (A) update rust generator mapping for oneOf/nullable so model_version is emitted as Option<String> in GenerateOptions; (B) change retry policy in rust http client: do not retry on 401/403, only on 429 and 5xx, add exponential backoff + jitter, cap attempts to 4; (C) add integration test that posts same prompt with pinned version and asserts deterministic token sequence length within tolerance.

emma: can you also add a small note in onboarding guide explaining how to pin model_version and why it's important for reproducible evals? customer will want a doc link.

sasha: will add docs link and tests. opening PRs: generator fix https://git.internal/redwood/rust-codegen/pull/18, sdk patch https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-rs/pull/29.

toby: timeline? demo tomorrow morning.

sasha: I'll try to land generator change and regenerate bindings today; if not possible we'll cut redwood-rs v0.1.4 that adds model_version manually and the retry fix.

ci-bot: created issues RNF-2740 (rust generator: model_version) and RNF-2741 (redwood-rs retry policy).

emma: confirmed REST workaround works locally and unblocked the customer for now. added sample-rust-app note.

sasha: tests added; PRs opened and requesting expedited review.

devx-bot: release note draft: \"Fix: Rust SDK: support model_version pinning in generate options and prevent retry on auth errors; improved retry backoff policy.\" scheduled for 0.1.4.

emma: thanks all. will validate patched crate once released.

devx-bot: thread archived.
